title: MERGE-XAI-SYNC C-09 (DRIFT 01 §3 S3/R6, image-budget eviction -> compaction) — TEXT-ONLY BEST-EFFORT ARM on the qwen lane (L-04; 06 says 'image-heavy session' — the 47 MiB inline-image induction is NOT expressible in the driver: no image-attach step op and the seed is text-only; the positive arm is the operator image-induction run per smoke/redteam/fixtures/merge-xai/c-09-image/META.json, DRIVER GAP C-09 in smoke/merge-xai/README.md). What the text arm pins on the post-merge path under our code (S3 silent-drift row: verify NO behavior change): (1) COMPACTION COMPLETES: a reasoning turn + an echo turn + /compact + a post-compact turn all close (exit 0, no acp_error, the post-compact turn delivers its exact terminal nonce); (2) VERBATIM-INPUT STABILITY FACE: the POST-COMPACT qwen request reaches 200 (the compacted input re-hydrates and is accepted on the strict responses wire — a broken compaction input 400s; the 06 C-09 'no broken compaction input' assertion on the reachable surface); (3) NO COMP-3 STORM: the qwen request band is 3..10 across the four-step flow (a compact-induced same-payload re-request storm = the COMP-3 defect class); (4) EVICTION-PLACEHOLDER NEGATIVE CONTROL (recon, expected ABSENT): the image-eviction placeholder literal ('An earlier image was removed to keep the request within its size limit …') is recorded over the session chat_history — on a text-only seed the 47 MiB trigger (image_budget.rs IMAGE_COMPACT_TRIGGER_BYTES = 50-3 MiB; target 25 MiB) CANNOT fire, so a PRESENT sighting = the eviction path fired on a text-only session = the budget gate regressed = defect (adjudicate on the record). VERDICT: PASS = compaction completes + post-compact 200 + band clean + placeholder absent-from-record; any scored red -> STOP-AND-REPORT (house rule).

steps.prompt: Compute 7^8432 mod 5557 using modular exponentiation. Show each squaring step briefly, then state the final remainder on its own line. Do not use any tools.

steps.note: ARM SCOPE (recon_note, non-scoring): this is the TEXT-ONLY best-effort arm — the 06 C-09 scenario names an image-heavy session (exceed the 47 MB inline-image budget; the eviction placeholder must then be PRESENT in history). The driver cannot attach images (no image-attach step op; the seed is text-only), so the placeholder pin here runs as a NEGATIVE CONTROL (expected absent) and the positive arm is the operator image-induction run (fixture smoke/redteam/fixtures/merge-xai/c-09-image/META.json: the 47 MiB arm procedure + redaction). The scored surface of this arm is the compaction machinery itself (completes, re-hydrates, no storm) — the S3/R6 drift row's reachable half. The board cross-references both arms.

ndjson.label: SESSION SURVIVES THE COMPACT: the /compact step and the post-compact turn did not die (a compact failure or a 400 on the re-hydrated input surfaces here) -> STOP.
POST-COMPACT TURN COMPLETES: the turn after /compact delivered the exact terminal nonce — the compaction closed and the session continued on the compacted history.

wire.label: VERBATIM-INPUT STABILITY FACE (the 06 C-09 'no broken compaction input' assertion on the reachable surface): the LAST qwen request (the post-compact turn's request, the compacted input) reached 200 — the compacted input re-hydrated and was accepted on the strict responses wire. A 400 here = the compaction produced a broken input = the S3 drift is live = defect -> STOP.

NO COMP-3 STORM: 3-5 = the clean shape (reasoning turn + echo + post-compact, plus the compact side call); 6-10 = tolerated slack (within-turn re-requests around the compact); <3 = the four-step premise failed (adjudicate); >10 = same-payload retry storm around the compaction (COMP-3 shape) = defect -> STOP.

wire.label: EVICTION-PLACEHOLDER NEGATIVE CONTROL (recon, expected ABSENT on a text-only seed): the image-budget eviction placeholder literal (image_budget.rs, 47 MiB trigger) recorded over the session chat_history. ABSENT = the budget gate behaved (no images, no eviction) — the expected shape. PRESENT = the eviction path fired on a text-only session = the budget gate regressed = defect (adjudicate on the record; the positive arm is the operator 47 MiB image-induction run, DRIVER GAP C-09). recon — always records, never fails.
